definitions.explanation: a victory achieved with difficulty, often by a slim margin

examples.japanese: 1-0⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{辛勝|しんしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{辛勝|しんしょう}だった⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{勝|か}ち→勝ち：02540_kachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{勝|か}ち→勝ち：02540_kachi⟧だ。
examples.english: It was a narrow win, but a win is a win.

examples.japanese: ⟦{延長戦|えんちょうせん}→延長戦：06540_enchousen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{辛勝|しんしょう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They narrowly won after extra time.

notes:
USAGE:
- {辛勝|しんしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to win narrowly)
- ⟦{辛|から}く→辛い：00638_karai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ (to barely win - related expression)
{辛|しん} here means "difficult" or "painful" (same kanji as ⟦{辛|から}い→辛い：00638_karai⟧/spicy, ⟦{辛|つら}い→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧/hard). The victory was not easy and may have come down to the wire.

VICTORY SCALE (by margin/effort):
- ⟦{圧勝|あっしょう}→圧勝：07903_asshou⟧ (overwhelming victory)
- {大勝|たいしょう} (big win)
- ⟦{快勝|かいしょう}→快勝：08237_kaishou⟧ (easy win)
- {辛勝|しんしょう} (narrow win)

DEFEAT COUNTERPART:
- ⟦{惜敗|せきはい}→惜敗：07904_sekihai⟧ (narrow defeat) - when you lose by a small margin

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{接戦|せっせん}→接戦：08176_sessen⟧ (close game)
- ⟦{僅差|きんさ}→僅差：11526_kinsa⟧ (slight difference)
